traditional_elements.description: Visible garment details only; never infer ethnicity, nationality or religion.

skullcap_visible.description: True only when a skullcap is clearly visible on the main subject.

beard_visible.description: True only when a beard is visible on the same subject. These are visual cues, not a religious or occupational inference.

unnatural_hair_color_visible.description: Clearly dyed non-natural hair color on the main subject; false when unclear.

piercing_visible.description: Clearly visible piercing on the main subject, excluding a single ordinary earring.

hair_below_ears_visible.description: Hair visibly extends below the ears; a weak style cue alone.

hair_over_eyes_visible.description: Hair visibly covers one or both eyes; a weak style cue alone.

playful_grimace_visible.description: Clearly deliberate playful facial grimace; false for ordinary smile, blink or unclear face.

serious_index_pose_visible.description: The main subject visibly raises an index finger near the face while making a neutral or serious expression; false if either part is unclear.

beard_absent_visible.description: Clearly visible chin and cheeks without a beard; hidden or uncertain face means false.

short_hair_or_bald_visible.description: Clearly visible short haircut or bald/shaved head; a covered or unclear head means false. No inference about the cause.

head_scar_visible.description: Clearly visible scar-like mark on the head or face, not a hair part, shadow, wrinkle or compression artifact. No inference about cause or medical history; uncertainty means false.

muscular_visible.description: Clearly visible developed musculature, not inferred from clothing or body weight.

non_muscular_visible.description: Body is clearly visible without pronounced musculature; unknown means false. Mutually exclusive with muscular_visible.

gentle_smile_visible.description: A clearly visible small relaxed smile on the main subject; only an expression in this image, not a personality trait.

relaxed_head_tilt_visible.description: A clearly visible slight head tilt together with relaxed eyebrows on the main subject. Not camera rotation or a personality judgement.

retro_90s.description: Visible 1990s costume or fashion cues only; never infer criminality.
